body:
Adds `research/terrain-twin`: exact incomplete-gamma law for braking distance on patchwise Gamma friction, a twin with independent per-cell friction certifies a stopping distance that spatially correlated terrain exceeds far more often than claimed (n=100 cells: 0.44/0.33/0.18 real exceedance at 1/3/10 patches vs claimed 0.001), finer cells are worse, the mean stopping distance is nearly right while the tail is not, and the measured patch count repairs it. Stylised, pure Python, 5 tests, no field data.

README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
